newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug air freight volume up 18.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug air freight volume up 18.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's air freight volume hit 736,000 tonnes in January to August, up 18.1 percent compared with the same period last year, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Total freight volume in the first eight months was nearly 1.774 billion tonnes, a drop of 0.2 percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper quoted official figures as showing.

Railway freight transport was up a year-on-year 1.4 percent to 1.074 billion tonnes while truck freight slipped by 3.9 percent to 293 million tonnes, said the newspaper, which is published by the official China Daily.
Boat freight was down 1.7 percent in the period to 406 million tonnes, it said, adding that major coastal ports handled 536 million tonnes of cargo, a rise of 9.2 percent.
Freight turnover in the period was down 2.1 percent to 1.92 trillion tonne-kilometres, it said.
The number of passengers totalled 3.27 billion in the first eight months, down by 0.3 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.
